verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that developers can author their own pieces in TypeScript and that a catalog of 760+ integrations exists. It never documents installing community-built pieces contributed from outside the vendor, nor any marketplace, registry or import mechanism for third-party pieces. Authoring your own piece is a developer building block, not the install capability the story asks for, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install community-built nodes, components, or integrations contributed outside the vendor
